chunks: And in the narration of ʿAmmār al-Sābāṭī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, he said:
If the midwife is a Jewess who does not eat from the slaughtered animal of the Muslims, she is to be given one-fourth of the value of the ram; that is purchased from her with it.

key_terms.الْمُسْلِمِينَ: the Muslims, whose slaughter is being referred to
key_terms.ذَبِيحَةِ: the slaughtered animal or its meat

ai.seo_question: What should be given to a Jewish midwife in the ʿaqiqah if she does not eat from the slaughter of Muslims?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling related to the ʿaqiqah arrangement when the midwife is a Jewish woman who does not eat meat slaughtered by Muslims. In such a case, she is compensated with one-fourth of the value of the ram instead of receiving a portion to eat.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4717 - In the narration of Ammar Al-Sabati from Abu Abdullah (as), that he said:
"If the midwife (qabilah) is a Jewess who does not eat the meat of an animal slaughtered by Muslims, she should be given one-fourth of the value of the ram, and it is purchased from her with that."
